explanation: Robert De Niro played the young Vito in The Godfather Part II (1974). Both men won Oscars for the role, the first time two actors did so for one character.

claims.text: Marlon Brando played Vito Corleone in The Godfather (1972).
In The Godfather, Al Pacino played Michael Corleone and James Caan played Sonny Corleone; Robert De Niro was not in the film.
Robert De Niro played the young Vito Corleone in The Godfather Part II (1974).
Brando won the Oscar for Best Actor and De Niro the Oscar for Best Supporting Actor for playing Vito Corleone.
Brando and De Niro were the first two actors to win Oscars for playing the same character.
